title: Agency Profile
description: Single source of truth for the agency operating the system. Captures the agency identity, the named agent(s) who send outreach, the sending mailbox(es) + warmup state, and the signature template baked into every email. v0.1 = single agency, single agent (`agents` and `sending_mailboxes` arrays both length 1). v2 will lift the single-agent constraint to multi-agent (e.g. Sarah handles 5 talents, Tom handles 3) without breaking the v0.1 shape — the array structure is already in place. Lives at `data/agency_profile.json` (gitignored — contains real agent contact details).

agency_id.description: Stable slug identifier for the agency. Used as the root identifier when v2 introduces multi-agency.

name.description: Display name of the agency, used in email signatures + intros.

domain.description: The agency's primary domain (e.g. `nativeagency.com`). All sending mailboxes are subdomains/addresses of this domain. SPF/DKIM/DMARC records live here.

logo_url.description: Optional. Used in signature blocks when the template supports HTML.

agents.description: v0.1: exactly one agent (constraint enforced via maxItems: 1). v2: maxItems lifted; multi-agent rosters supported with per-agent talent assignment.

sending_mailboxes.description: Mailboxes the agency sends outreach from. v0.1 typically = 1 (the primary agent's mailbox). Each mailbox is independently warmed up in Smartlead.

company_address.description: Physical mailing address. REQUIRED for CAN-SPAM compliance — every cold email must include the sender's physical address in the footer. Composed into the email signature.

unsubscribe_email.description: Address that handles List-Unsubscribe responses. Typically `unsubscribe@{domain}` or a dedicated inbox. Drives the one-click unsubscribe required by Gmail/Yahoo Feb 2024 rules.

default_signature_template.description: Email signature block. Supports merge fields: `{agent_name}`, `{agent_title}`, `{agent_email}`, `{agent_phone}`, `{agency_name}`, `{agency_website}`, `{agency_address}`, `{unsubscribe_link}`. Required to end every outreach email; the orchestrator validates presence at send-time.

default_voice_mode.description: How the LLM positions agent vs talent in generated emails. v0.1 default per user decision: agent-led on-behalf-of. v2 may add per-talent overrides.

agent_id.description: Stable slug identifier for the agent.

name.description: Agent's full name as it appears in the FROM line + signature.

email.description: Agent's primary inbox. Replies route here. May or may not equal the sending mailbox (agencies sometimes send from `sarah@` and receive at `partnerships@`).

title.description: Job title for the signature (e.g. 'Director of Brand Partnerships').

is_primary.description: True for the agent who acts as the default sender when an explicit per-talent agent isn't assigned. v0.1: must be true (only one agent). v2: exactly one agent must be primary.

represents_talent_ids.description: v0.1: agent represents all talents (this array may be empty as a 'represents everyone' signal, or contain all talent_ids). v2: explicit assignment enables agent-to-talent routing — each talent's outreach uses their assigned agent's mailbox + signature.

email.description: The address emails are sent FROM. Must be on the agency's domain.

agent_id.description: FK to `agents[].agent_id`. The agent this mailbox represents.

purpose.description: named_agent_outreach: `sarah@agency.com` style, brand sees the agent's name on the FROM line — v0.1 default per user decision. generic_agency_outreach: `partnerships@agency.com` — used in v2 as fallback. transactional: agency's reply-handling inbox, not for outbound.

warmup_status.description: Lifecycle: pending = DNS not yet verified; in_progress = Smartlead warmup running (typically 2-4 weeks); complete = ready for cold outreach; paused = manually held.

dns_records_verified.description: True when SPF + DKIM + DMARC records are all confirmed for the agency's domain. Gating condition before warmup can start.

smartlead_mailbox_id.description: Identifier in Smartlead's mailbox registry. Set after Smartlead onboards the mailbox.

daily_send_cap.description: Maximum cold emails this mailbox sends per day. Ramps up during warmup; typically caps at 100-200/day for sustainable deliverability.
